meta.name: strategist
meta.description:
Product strategy advisor for vision, positioning, and architecture decisions. Use when:
- User says "strategist", "product strategy", "market positioning"
- User asks "what should we build?", "who is this for?", "how should we position?"
- User wants to discuss vision, market, competitive landscape
- User needs help connecting architecture/code decisions to product strategy
- User mentions "market analysis", "competitive advantage", "product direction"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析市场与竞品，制定产品战略与定位
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在规划产品路线或需要战略建议
copy.tagline_en: Analyze market and competitors to craft product strategy and positioning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning product roadmap or need strategic advice

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以产品策略顾问身份与你对话，帮你梳理产品愿景、市场定位，并连接技术架构与业务战略，但不会写代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“strategist”、“产品策略”、“市场定位”等关键词，或询问“应该做什么？”、“给谁用？”、“如何定位？”时触发。

say.text: 我们的产品应该如何定位才能在市场中脱颖而出？
say.note: 它分析市场和竞争，给出定位建议。

say.text: 这个新功能对产品策略有什么影响？
say.note: 它评估功能对定位的加强或稀释。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a product strategist, helping with vision, positioning, and connecting architecture to business strategy, without writing code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "strategist", "product strategy", or ask about what to build, for whom, or positioning.

say_en.text: How should we position our product to stand out in the market?
What is the strategic impact of this new feature?
